mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_ITINERARY_BLOCK ( day_id, place_id, source_block_id, block_type, block_order, title, memo, cost, start_time, end_time ) VALUES ( #{dayId}, #{placeId}, #{sourceBlockId}, #{blockType}, #{blockOrder}, #{title}, #{memo}, #{cost}, #{startTime}, #{endTime} )
mapper.select: SELECT block_id, day_id, place_id, source_block_id, block_type, block_order, title, memo, cost, start_time, end_time FROM TB_ITINERARY_BLOCK WHERE day_id = #{dayId} ORDER BY block_order ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_ITINERARY_BLOCK SET place_id = #{placeId}, source_block_id = #{sourceBlockId}, block_type = #{blockType}, block_order = #{blockOrder}, title = #{title}, memo = #{memo}, cost = #{cost}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime} WHERE block_id = #{blockId} AND day_id = #{dayId}
